name: Dyess AFB
description: Home of the 7th Bomb Wing and 317th Airlift Wing. Dyess AFB operates B-1B Lancer and C-130J Super Hercules aircraft, supporting global strike and mobility missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

events.title: 3 Day TAP Class
events.description: 3-Day Mandatory Transition Class for all separating and retiring service members. Must complete Initial Counseling and Pre-Separation before attending. Please call 325-696-5999 for information or to sign up. Contact: Misti Hauger Email: misti.hauger.1@us.af.mil Phone: 325-696-5999

events.title: Fatherhood Effect Workshop
events.description: The Fatherhood EFFECT program offers workshops designed for fathers and father figures using the evidence-based 24/7 Dad curriculum. These sessions help dads build strong family bonds, improve communication, and handle everyday parenting challenges. Contact: Military & Family Readiness Center Email: 7FSS.A.FRC@us.af.mil Phone: 325-696-5999

events.title: EFMP Town Hall
events.description: All EFMP families are invited to come talk about their triumphs and tribulations regarding the Exceptional Family Member Program. Share your experiences with past events and provide ideas for future workshops/events. Learn about on and off base resources that may be helpful to your family. No registration required HOT TOPICS to be discussed by SME's & determined by EFMP current concerns. Contact: Jennifer Merritt & A

events.title: EFMP ‘SSI & SSDI'
events.description: Come learn about SSI and SSDI, including who is eligible, how to apply, and what documentation is needed. Ask your questions to an expert! Must register to attend. Please call the M&FRC at 325-696-5999 or email the EFMP-FS Org Box at 7FSS.FSH.EFMP -FamilySupport@us.af.mil . events.title: Basic Budgeting
events.description: Learn the basic tenets of money management, controlling spending, and taking back control of personal finances. Attendees will build a detailed household budget along with instructions on how to continue to use it in the future to maintain their financial awareness. The budget will also be used for members to present to their leadership for the purposes of moving out of the dormitory. Contact: Military & Family Readiness Center Email: 7fss.a.frc@us.af.mil Phone: 325-696-5999

events.title: Family Movie Night Featuring Casper
events.address: 210 Theater Rd, Dyess Air Force Base, TX, 79607-1212
events.description: Casper (1995) – Free Community Movie Night Join us at the Hangar Center for a cozy throwback screening of the 1995 classic Casper ! Bring your friends, family, and dorm buddies for a fun, feel‑good evening with free popcorn and plenty of nostalgia. 📅 Date & Time Tuesday, October 6 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM 🎬 About the Movie We’re showing the original 1995 film featuring everyone’s favorite friendly ghost. Perfect for all ages. 🍿 Concessions Free entry + free popcorn Additional concessions available for purchase Hosted by Force Support Squadron & Air Force Community Center

events.title: Make & Take Crafts
events.description: Every 2nd & 4th Thursday (excluding holidays) during the school year, join your Dyess Library for Make & Take Crafts! Crafts will vary between easy craft kits to more detailed projects. While some crafts might require a little more dexterity and parent assistant for our younger crafters, all ages are welcome. Available while supplies last. Call the library at 325-696-6873 for more information. Contact: Sara Ritson Email: sara.ritson@us.af.mil Phone: 325-696-68732

events.title: Using a Cricut to craft: Spooky Doormat Painting
events.address: 357 Ave B, Dyess Air Force Base, TX, 79607-1212
events.description: Kick off our three‑part Cricut crafting series with a hands‑on Halloween doormat workshop! Learn how to use the Cricut machine and design software, then paint your own spooky doormat using pre‑made vinyl stencils. Perfect for families, beginners, and anyone wanting to explore the creative tools available at Dyess. 📅 Date & Time: Thursday, October 8, 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM 💲 Cost: $10 for members, $15 for non‑members 👨‍👩‍👧 Family Friendly Ages 6+ (with supervision) 📍 Location: Hangar Center, 357 Ave B (Building 7106) (325) 696‑7950

events.title: Survival Camp
events.description: Youth Center & Outdoor Rec: Ultimate Overnight Survival Camp Get ready for an unforgettable night under the stars! The Youth Center has teamed up with Outdoor Rec to bring you the ultimate Overnight Survival Camp. Whether you are a wilderness beginner or a seasoned outdoors enthusiast, this hands-on event is packed with real-world outdoor skills, great food, and friendly competition. Event Highlights & Activities Activity Feature Description Real Tent Setup Learn the ins and outs of campsite selection and pitch real tents like a wilderness pro. Fire Masterclass Master essential fire safety pro

events.title: Dungeons & Dragons
events.description: Interested in playing Dungeons & Dragons but never have? Enjoy playing but don’t have a current group? Join the library in our family friendly Dungeons & Dragons game. For new and experienced players. Contact: Sara Ritson Email: sara.ritson@us.af.mil Phone: 325-696-6873

events.title: EFMP Sensory Movie
events.description: We will be showing “Hotel Transylvania 2” with water, popcorn and candy provided while supplies last. See attached flyer for full details. This is a great opportunity for anyone with ASD (Autism Spectrum Disorder) or SPD (Sensory Processing Disorder) to see how they react attending movies – without paying an arm or a leg at the movie theater! events.title: EFMP 101
events.description: Learn how the 3 components of EFMP (Mdical, Assignments & Family Support) work together to support an Exceptional Families needs, including enrollment, disenrollment, reassignments, education and resources. Registration required. Please call the M&FRC at 325-696-5999 or email the EFMP-FS Org Box at 7FSS.FSH.EFMP-FamilySupport@us.af.mil . sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dyess Inn (325-696-2681) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (325-696-4403) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 7 FSS, M&FRC, and official Dyess sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
